standard.summary: （实验性）SDS-LoRA（Spectral Decomposed Symmetric LoRA）：对 LoRA 的 A/B 矩阵做谱分解，通过正交化保证 LoRA 更新的各向同性，防止训练过程中出现的奇异值偏态（少数方向主导更新）。
standard.effect: 开启后 LoRA 更新在各方向更均匀（各向异性消除），有助于稳定训练、防止某些特征方向过度拟合。
standard.whenToUse: 实验性功能，实现已完成并验证（7/7 smoke 通过）。与标准 LoRA parity 兼容，默认 off。
standard.avoidWhen: 默认关闭。SDS-LoRA 在 LLM/ViT 上验证，DiT（Anima）未全面验证，建议先实验确认效果再用于正式训练。

standard_en.summary: (Experimental) SDS-LoRA (Spectral Decomposed Symmetric LoRA): it spectrally decomposes LoRA's A/B matrices and orthogonalises them to keep the LoRA update isotropic, which prevents the singular-value skew that appears during training (a few directions dominating the update).
standard_en.effect: Once enabled the LoRA update is more even across directions (the anisotropy is removed), which helps stabilise training and stops particular feature directions from overfitting.
standard_en.whenToUse: An experimental feature; the implementation is finished and verified (7/7 smokes pass). It keeps parity with standard LoRA and is off by default.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Off by default. SDS-LoRA was verified on LLMs and ViTs, not fully on DiT (Anima), so experiment and confirm the effect before using it for real training.

advanced.principle: 维护 Q_A/Q_B 的 detached buffer（不参与 autograd），对 A/B 做定期 QR 刷新（orthogonalization）使梯度条件数降低（实测从 8.28 → 2.71）。warmup 阶段先做 SVD 重参数化，确保训练初期权重已正交化。系数 1/(2s) 而非论文的 1/√(2s)（原论文有笔误）。
advanced.tradeoffs: QR 刷新有额外计算开销（每 N 步一次 SVD/QR，约 1~5ms）；orthogonalization 改变了梯度传播路径，与标准 LoRA 的训练轨迹不同（虽然初始权重 parity）。

advanced_en.principle: Maintains detached buffers of Q_A/Q_B (not part of autograd) and periodically QR-refreshes A/B (orthogonalization), lowering the gradient condition number (measured 8.28 → 2.71). A warmup phase does SVD reparameterization first, ensuring weights are orthogonalized early in training. The coefficient is 1/(2s), not the paper's 1/√(2s) (a typo in the original paper).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: QR refreshes add compute (one SVD/QR every N steps, about 1~5ms); orthogonalization changes the gradient propagation path, so the training trajectory differs from standard LoRA (even though the initial weights are at parity).
